record.original_question: Find an analog of the asymptotic lower matching conjecture for arbitrary infinite r-regular graphs, at least for matching densities p in [0, 2/3]. In other words, determine a lower-bound principle for p-matching entropy in the non-bipartite infinite regular setting that plays the role that ALMC plays for bipartite infinite regular graphs.

evidence.quote: There should be a similar inequality for infinite r-regular graphs, at least for p in [0, 2/3] as we explain in Section 7. However we do not have the precise version of such inequality.
We close this section with open problems for infinite regular non-bipartite graphs. First one, find an analog of the LAMC for any infinite r-regular infinite graph for p in [0, 2/3].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let G be an r-regular (possibly infinite) graph, and for an integer k ≥ 0 let m_k(G_n) denote the number of matchings of size k in a finite graph G_n. For a sequence {G_n} of finite r-regular graphs with |V(G_n)| → ∞ that converges in the Benjamini–Schramm sense to an infinite r-regular graph G, and for p ∈ [0, 1] (the matching density, where k = ⌊p|V(G_n)|/2⌋), define the p-matching entropy by
    h_G(p) = lim sup_{n→∞} (1/|V(G_n)|) log m_{⌊p|V(G_n)|/2⌋}(G_n).

For the infinite r-regular tree T_r, the entropy function p ↦ h_{T_r}(p) is explicit and known. The Asymptotic Lower Matching Conjecture (ALMC), now a theorem in the bipartite setting, asserts that for every r-regular bipartite (finite or infinite limit) graph G and every p ∈ [0, 1],
    h_G(p) ≥ h_{T_r}(p),
i.e., among r-regular bipartite graphs the infinite r-regular tree minimizes the p-matching entropy.

Problem. Formulate and establish a non-bipartite analog of the ALMC for arbitrary infinite r-regular graphs, at least in the range p ∈ [0, 2/3]. That is, identify an explicit lower bound function L_r(p) (defined for p ∈ [0, 2/3]) such that for every infinite r-regular graph G arising as a Benjamini–Schramm limit of finite r-regular graphs, one has
    h_G(p) ≥ L_r(p)    for all p ∈ [0, 2/3],
and such that L_r plays for general (not necessarily bipartite) r-regular graphs the role that h_{T_r} plays in the bipartite ALMC. Determine the optimal such L_r(p).
artifact.status_search_result: The bipartite Lower Matching Conjecture (and its asymptotic version) has been proved (e.g., Csikvári; Lelarge), but the literature on infinite r-regular non-bipartite graphs notes that the analogous lower bound for p-matching entropy in the non-bipartite setting, particularly for p ∈ [0, 2/3], remains an open problem with no precise inequality established.

status_evidence.title: Lower matching conjecture, and a new proof of Schrijver's and Gurvits's theorems
status_evidence.snippet: Proof of the bipartite Lower Matching Conjecture; non-bipartite analog not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: Bipartite case is solved; non-bipartite analog for infinite r-regular graphs is not established.

status_evidence.title: Matchings and Independent Sets of a Fixed Size in Regular Graphs (arXiv:1206.3211)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses p-matching entropy on infinite regular trees and bipartite ALMC; raises non-bipartite questions.
status_evidence.claim: Non-bipartite analog of ALMC for infinite r-regular graphs is posed as an open question.
